identity_fields_describe: 2026-11-18 v10: boss and elite special mechanics checked line by line against native: Knowledge Demon Curse of Knowledge is a real player choice during the enemy turn (Disintegration 6/7/8 vs Mind Rot / Sloth / Waste Away; the enemy turn suspends and resumes) and the four curse powers work; Queen Chains of Binding is the native Bound affliction (3 drawn cards per turn, one Bound card playable per turn, cleared at turn end) instead of +1 cost; Test Subject knock-out removes every power except Adaptable/Painful Stabs (Enrage, Strength, debuffs); Slippery caps HP loss after block (block absorbs the full hit) and only loses a stack when HP was lost; HP-loss modifier order Hardened Shell -> Intangible/Slippery -> The Boot; Vantom Slippery 8 (A8+: 9); Infested Prism Vital Spark is the native Tainted affliction (Skills; playing one gives Tainted 2/3: +damage from enemy attacks until the enemy turn ends) instead of energy on hit; Globe Head Galvanic 8 at A9; Ceremonial Beast Plow break also removes temporary Strength loss; Spectral Knight's Hex ends when it dies; Magi Knight's Dampen downgrades upgraded cards until it dies.
